# tracing-kit v2.0.5 (unreleased)

This candidate refreshes indirect requirements used by the optional OTLP
exporter. It contains no library source changes.

| Module | Previous | Candidate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2` | v2.33.0 | v2.34.0 |
| `go.opentelemetry.io/auto/sdk` | v1.2.1 | v1.2.2 |
| `golang.org/x/net` | v0.62.0 | v0.63.0 |
| `golang.org/x/sys` | v0.49.0 | v0.50.0 |
| `golang.org/x/text` | v0.43.0 | v0.44.0 |
| `google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/api` | v0.0.0-20261026165753-2ffab32bce7e | v0.0.0-20261123191846-1e707ab9fbc2 |
| `google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/rpc` | v0.0.0-20261026165753-2ffab32bce7e | v0.0.0-20261123191846-1e707ab9fbc2 |

OpenTelemetry remains v1.47.0 and the Go requirement remains 1.27.4.

After publication:

```sh
go get github.com/soulteary/tracing-kit/v2@v2.0.5
```

For rollback, restore the application's previous `go.mod` and `go.sum`, then
rebuild. Downgrading tracing-kit alone may leave newer indirect requirements
selected in the application.
